# Wire EDM Pro

> Sydney precision machining business with over 25 years of experience: wire EDM cutting, EDM hole drilling, CNC milling, CNC turning and laser cutting for manufacturing, mining, medical, defence and general engineering. Based at 16/24 Garling Rd, Kings Park NSW 2148, Australia.

## Solutions

- [EDM Wire Cutting Solution](https://wireedmpro.com.au/edm-wire-cutting/): Wire EDM to ±0.003 mm in hardened metal up to 420 mm tall, burr-free, any conductive metal
- [Milling solutions](https://wireedmpro.com.au/milling/): CNC milling on a DMG MORI ecoMill 600 V, jigs, fixtures, die sets and production runs
- [Turning solutions](https://wireedmpro.com.au/turning/): CNC turning and laser-cut sheet metal profiles
- [EDM Drills](https://wireedmpro.com.au/edm-drills/): small hole EDM drilling from 0.3 mm to 3.0 mm in hardened metal
- [Quality Assurance](https://wireedmpro.com.au/quality-assurance/): first-article, critical-dimension and batch inspection on calibrated instruments
- [Reverse Engineering](https://wireedmpro.com.au/reverse-engineering/): sample measured, modelled in Mastercam and manufactured turnkey

## Industries

- [Tool & Die Making](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/tool-die-making/): Punches, dies and mould components
- [Sheet Metal Components](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/sheet-metal-components/): Press tooling and wire-cut profiles for sheet metal work
- [Aerospace & Defence](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/aerospace-defence/): Exotic alloys, burr-free, no cutting force
- [Medical](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/medical/): Stainless and titanium, edges that pass inspection
- [Mining](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/mining/): Hardened wear parts and fast spares
- [Automotive](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/automotive/): Prototypes, tooling and motorsport one-offs
- [Electronics](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/electronics/): Fine-feature tooling for connectors and stampings
- [Energy](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/energy/): Power generation and renewables spares
- [Machine Building](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/machine-building/): The precision details inside custom machines
- [Robotics & Automation](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/robotics-automation/): Exact fits for moving assemblies
- [Manufacturers](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/manufacturers/): Food lid containers, packaging tooling and production parts
- [General Engineering](https://wireedmpro.com.au/industries/general-engineering/): One-offs, repairs and everything between
